title: One to Five — Where the Character Is the Count
label: ch:zh-numbers
canDo: I can count from one to five in Mandarin and read all five characters cold and out of order, and I know which of them I could have worked out and which I simply had to learn.

payoff.summary: The five numerals read out of sequence, then off a lift panel with the fourth floor missing — and the reader knows why it is missing.
